title: Learn English with new LangoPlay – level 2
paragraphs: We have a new version of the game LangoPlay. It is ready for you. It has three new things which make learning easier. What are they?
First, we simplified the design. The new design is cleaner and more intuitive.
We also added five new videos. These short videos explain different parts of the game step by step. They help students understand how the game works. The videos are useful for all players.

We also improved the statistics section. Students can now see their learning progress more clearly. They can see how many words they already learned and how many words they can learn in the next chapter.

The new design, videos, and improved statistics create a more comfortable learning experience. LangoPlay is now easier to understand and easier to use for students who want to improve their English every day.
Try the new LangoPlay. Start to play today. You can start for free. Go to www.langoplay.com.
